title: Nonlinear Drivers of Macroeconomic Tail Risk: A Threshold Stochastic Volatility-in-Mean VAR with Regime-Dependent Leverage
abstract: arXiv:2609.26994v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The tails of macroeconomic outcomes can respond differently from the centre of their distribution: shocks with modest effects on median growth or inflation can shift downside growth or upside inflation risk. We develop a threshold stochastic-volatility-in-mean VAR with regime-dependent leverage to study their structural drivers. The model allows endogenous interactions between outcomes and volatility, contemporaneous level-volatility dependence, and regime-specific propagation. In nearly 150 years of U.S. data, predictive model selection supports three inflation-defined regimes. We identify business-cycle, financial, macroeconomic-uncertainty, and financial-uncertainty shocks and decompose their contributions to growth- and inflation-at-risk. translated_title: 宏观经济尾部风险的非线性驱动因素：具有区制依赖杠杆的阈值随机波动率均值VAR
translated_abstract: 宏观经济结果的尾部可能与分布中心的反应方式不同：对增长或通胀中位数影响温和的冲击，可能会改变下行增长风险或上行通胀风险。我们开发了一个具有区制依赖杠杆的阈值随机波动率均值VAR模型来研究其结构性驱动因素。该模型允许结果与波动率之间的内生互动、同期的水平-波动率依赖关系，以及区制特定的传播机制。在近150年的美国数据中，预测模型选择支持三个以通胀定义的区制。我们识别出商业周期、金融、宏观经济不确定性和金融不确定性冲击，并分解它们对增长风险和通胀风险的贡献。尾部风险的结构构成与预测中位数不同。商业周期冲击主导了GNP增长的中位数反应，但在尾部风险中所占份额要小得多（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文开发了一个具有区制依赖杠杆的阈值随机波动率均值VAR模型，利用近150年的美国数据识别出商业周期、金融和不确定性等结构性冲击，并发现尾部风险的结构构成与预测中位数存在显著差异。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a threshold stochastic volatility-in-mean VAR with regime-dependent leverage, identifies business-cycle, financial, and uncertainty shocks from nearly 150 years of U.S. data, and shows that the structural composition of macroeconomic tail risk differs markedly from that of the predictive median.
